name: seo-location-page-audit
summary: Audit location and service-area pages for local usefulness, business purpose, intent fit, facts, internal links, schema, and doorway risk.
inputs: business type, locations, service areas, market, language
approved business, page, local, analytics, and Brand evidence
external_reads: approved external page, provider, maps, listing, analytics, GSC, and manual evidence
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live external provider or page reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: URL, redirect, canonical, indexability, schema, CMS, code, copy, and production changes are out of scope
done_when: business type, locations, service areas, market, language, scope, date, and page set are explicit
facts, evidence, unique value, intent fit, duplication/thinness, and doorway risk are distinct and source-labeled
recommendations have evidence, owner, and recheck
copy, schema, CMS, Development, Writing, and Strategy handoffs are explicit
no doorway-page, mutation, or outcome guarantee is made
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify unavailable sources produced no fabricated page facts
verify no URL, redirect, canonical, indexability, schema, CMS, code, copy, or production mutation occurred
verify changed artifact and review registration when applicable
